text:
marta: Heads-up — noticed the Python SDK returns 404 for the private-models endpoint while the REST call works fine. Causing our sampleapp onboarding to fail during model pinning.

kai: omg that's rough, can you paste request + response?

marta: here's what I see from the sampleapp logs:
```
POST /v1/private/models/pin
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Body: {"model_id": "redwood-123"}

Response 404 {"error": "Not found"}

curl to the same URL returns 200 with model metadata.
```

ben: is this the Python sdk or node? which version?

marta: python sdk 0.9.2 from pip. sampleapp uses our onboarding flow that calls `client.private.models.pin(model_id)`

sam-sdk: pinging from SDK side — quick suspicion: we had a change where private endpoints were moved under `/v1/enterprise/...` and the SDK should map the `private` method to that path. maybe 0.9.2 didn't get the mapping.

marta: interesting — but curl to `/v1/enterprise/private/models/pin` also returns 200. The SDK call seems to hit `/v1/private/models/pin`.

sam-sdk: can you dump the request URL the SDK actually constructs? there's a debug flag: `REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1`

marta: enabled it and got this: `https://api.redwood.ai/v1/private/models/pin` — so yep, SDK isn't routing to enterprise path.

ci-bot: @sam-sdk assigned issue RDW-4578 (sdk: private endpoint routing) — created draft PR template. :robot_face:

sam-sdk: thanks. I'll open a quick PR to map `client.private.models.*` to `/v1/enterprise/private/models/*` when `client.config.tenant_type == 'enterprise'`.

olivia: will that change affect hosted users? we don't want to break public endpoint users.

sam-sdk: good call — plan: default behavior unchanged; if config.tenant_type is unset, keep current route. For orgs using Private deployments they set `tenant_type=enterprise` in config (we document this in onboarding). I'll add tests for both routes.

ben: add a backwards-compatibility test that simulates a 404 on the old route and checks SDK retries to the enterprise route once (and logs a warning).

sam-sdk: hmm prefer explicit config over implicit fallback. I'll do both: if tenant_type set -> enterprise route; else if 404 and header `X-Enterprise-Suggest: true` is present -> retry to enterprise and emit warning.

marta: that sounds good — unblocks sampleapp onboarding. Any ETA?

sam-sdk: I can open PR today, get review tomorrow, and cut 0.9.3 patch by EOD Fri.

kai: can we also capture this in docs quickstart wording — we had a `private` example but no note about tenant_type for Python.

olivia: I'll add a one-liner to the quickstart and the migration FAQ.

marta: re-tested sampleapp against my local SDK build (patched) — onboarding flow proceeds past model pin step now. :tada:

sam-sdk: awesome, will merge tonight. adding changelog entry: "fix: private models route mapping for enterprise tenants (python)"

ben: post-merge, let's run a canary in staging for a day, then promote.

marta: thanks all. leaving the thread open until the release is published.

ci-bot: PR merged into `main` (sam-sdk) — build pipeline triggered.

marta: verified staging build (1851234801) — onboarding flow green. closing once 0.9.3 published.

sam-sdk: 0.9.3 published to PyPI. changelog and quickstart updated.

marta: confirmed sampleapp onboarding works with 0.9.3. :white_check_mark:

olivia: docs patched. moving note into migration guide.

ben: nice work, team.
